title: Data-Driven Selling & Analytics
description: This is a competency-based course designed for the indentured Technical Sales Representative apprentice.
learning_objectives: Choose the small set of sales metrics that should drive a rep's weekly decisions
Read a pipeline report for conversion, velocity, and coverage, and say what it implies
Diagnose where a personal funnel is leaking and name the likely cause
Build a CRM dashboard that answers a stated question rather than displaying everything
Turn an analysis of sales data into a changed plan with a measurable target
prerequisites: Advanced SaaS Sales Strategies (se201), for SaaS metric definitions
CRM System Mastery & Sales Automation (se301), for the CRM data this course reads

lessons.title: The Metrics That Drive Decisions
objectives: Choose the small set of sales metrics that should drive a rep's weekly decisions

sequencing_rationale: Metric literacy (2) precedes report reading (3), which precedes self-diagnosis (4); dashboards (5) come only after the learner knows which question a dashboard should answer, and the project (6) forces the analysis to end in a decision rather than a chart.
